text: Chapter 14: Mainland Toram@Fierce Battle with Mutant Lixis
A big wooden tub is needed to transport Mare and Aga to\nAqua Gota! Let's gather the materials needed quickly!
You watch the ark carrying Mare and the others safely take\noff. Next, head to Lixaro Ghost Town to find Anono's friends\nand the royal dragon cocoon!
As you arrive at the entrance of Lixaro Ghost Town, you\nrealize it has long been abandoned and has become a den of\nmonsters. Clear out the enemies and let's keep moving!
As you go further, you find creatures looking like Lixis.\nHowever, they appear to have been corroded and they attack\nyou. Defeat them and head to the urban area!
You have arrived in the urban area of Lixaro Ghost Town.\nHowever, the Lixis here are even more violent.\nBattle them to reach the mansion's garden!
When you arrive at the mansion's garden, you are confronted\nby a group of beastlike Lixis. Beat them first to ensure\nyour safety!
After defeating the beastlike Lixis, a beastly cry echoes\nthrough the area. Looks like it's not over yet.\nEnter the mansion!
You are struggling against the crystal monster. Then someone\nattacks and hits it, sending it reeling in pain. Don't miss\nthis chance! Beat the Supreme Evil Crystal Beast now!
